cards.Back:
核心义：大灾难，严重灾祸。
语气：正式、严重，比 disaster 更书面，比 accident 更灾难化。
引申义：可指社会、制度、技术或道德层面的重大失败。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：AI has not yet caused a calamity, but it might. 作者用 calamity 把 AI 风险提升到公共灾难级别，为“提前监管”铺垫。
暗示：不是普通风险，而是可能触发制度性回应的大危机。
例句1 科技：A powerful technology may bring convenience, but without rules it can also lead to calamity.
例句2 社会：The spread of misinformation could become a public calamity if citizens lose trust in facts.
例句3 环境：Climate change is not a distant inconvenience, but a potential calamity for vulnerable communities.
可用场景：科技伦理、环境保护、公共安全、社会责任。

cards.Back:
核心义：从灾难中产生。
引申义：制度、规则、改革往往由失败或危机倒逼出来。
语气：带有历史总结意味，适合议论文开头。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：New rules often come out of disasters. 作者用美联储、FDA、SEC 的历史证明监管常在灾后出现。
暗示：AI 最好不要等灾难发生后才立规矩。
例句1 教育：Better school rules often come out of painful lessons, but wise educators should act earlier.
例句2 公共治理：Many safety standards come out of disasters that reveal hidden weaknesses.
例句3 写作模板：A mature society should not wait for rules to come out of disasters.
可用场景：社会责任、科技监管、校园安全、环境治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：自愿性标准，非强制规范。
引申义：行业自律、软性监管。
语气：中性，但在公共风险语境中可能暗示“不够硬”。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：政府与 AI 公司制定 voluntary standards，但作者认为现有努力混乱。
暗示：只靠企业自愿可能不够，需要制度化 formalise。
例句1 科技：Voluntary standards can guide innovation, but they cannot replace public accountability.
例句2 职场：Companies may adopt voluntary standards to protect employee data.
例句3 作文：When public safety is at stake, voluntary standards should be backed by clear rules.
可用场景：AI 监管、企业社会责任、食品安全、平台治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：加了护栏/安全限制的。
AI 语境：指模型被设置安全边界，不能随意回答危险请求。
引申义：被制度、规则或技术限制住。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Fable 是 Mythos 的 guardrailed version。作者暗示即使“加了护栏”，政府仍然不放心。
暗示：护栏不等于绝对安全，也可能成为政治争论的焦点。
例句1 AI：A guardrailed model may refuse harmful instructions, but its underlying capability remains powerful.
例句2 教育：Children need guardrailed access to the internet rather than total isolation from technology.
例句3 管理：Innovation should be encouraged, but guardrailed by ethical principles.
可用场景：AI 安全、青少年上网、科技伦理、教育技术。

cards.Back:
核心义：突然对某人/某物施加管制或处罚。
语气：新闻英语，动作感强，常暗示粗暴、突然、行政性强。
搭配：be slapped with sanctions / fines / export controls。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Anthropic was slapped with export controls. 作者用 slapped 表示政府动作突然且带惩罚色彩。
政治意味：不是温和监管，而是行政力量直接压下去。
例句1 国际关系：The company was slapped with sanctions after violating export rules.
例句2 社会：Platforms that ignore child safety may be slapped with heavy fines.
例句3 作文：Punishment alone is not enough; firms also need clear guidance before they are slapped with penalties.
可用场景：法律监管、国际制裁、平台治理、企业责任。

cards.Front: make up rules on the fly
cards.Back:
核心义：边做边定规则，临时拼凑规则。
语气：批评性强，暗示不专业、不稳定、缺少制度设计。
熟词：on the fly = 临时地、现场地、边进行边处理。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：政府似乎在 make up rules on the fly。作者批评其 AI 监管没有清晰原则。
政治意味：政策不是 rule-based，而是 improvisation。
例句1 教育：Schools should not make up rules on the fly when dealing with AI homework.
例句2 政策：A government that makes up rules on the fly will lose public trust.
例句3 职场：Managers should not make up rules on the fly whenever a problem appears.
可用场景：公共治理、学校管理、职场制度、AI 监管。

cards.Back:
核心义：民族主义色彩。
熟词辟义：tinge 本义是淡淡的颜色，引申为某种意味、倾向、色彩。
语气：通常带轻微负面，表示某种立场不完全明说但能感觉到。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：AI 政策带有 unpleasant nationalistic tinge。作者批评美国优先主义。
政治意味：不是纯粹安全监管，而混入“美国人优先”的意识形态。
例句1 国际关系：The policy has a nationalistic tinge, even though it is presented as a security measure.
例句2 文化：Patriotism can inspire responsibility, but a nationalistic tinge may narrow people's worldview.
例句3 作文：Global challenges require cooperation, not policies with a narrow nationalistic tinge.
可用场景：国际合作、文化交流、科技竞争、全球治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：优先于，重要性高于。
语气：正式、议论文高频，用于排序价值和原则。
搭配：safety / public interest / education / long-term development takes precedence over profit / convenience。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Americans' AI access takes precedence over foreigners'. 作者指出美国政府把本国访问权放在外国人之前。
暗示：表面是安全监管，实际涉及利益排序。
例句1 作文：Public safety should take precedence over commercial profit.
例句2 教育：In education, students' long-term growth should take precedence over short-term scores.
例句3 环境：Environmental protection must take precedence over reckless expansion.
可用场景：社会责任、教育、环境、科技伦理、公共利益。

cards.Back:
核心义：前沿人工智能，能力处于最前沿的 AI 系统。
引申义：代表未知边界、高潜力、高风险。
语气：技术政策词，常和 regulation, safety, governance 搭配。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Regulating frontier AI is tricky. 作者承认前沿 AI 很难监管。
暗示：frontier 不是普通技术，而是靠近能力边界和风险边界。
例句1 AI：Frontier AI may transform research, but it also requires careful oversight.
例句2 经济：Countries that lead in frontier AI may gain enormous economic leverage.
例句3 作文：When frontier technologies enter daily life, ethical rules must keep pace.
可用场景：科技创新、国家竞争、科技伦理、社会治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：开放权重的，模型参数可被获取、运行或改动。
区分：open-weight 不完全等于 open-source；代码、训练数据、许可证未必完全开放。
语气：AI 治理关键词。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：中国许多顶尖模型是 open-weight，任何人都能 run or tinker with them。
暗示：开放降低门槛，也让封锁更难执行。
例句1 AI：Open-weight models spread quickly because researchers can adapt them to local needs.
例句2 教育：Open tools can reduce inequality if students are taught how to use them responsibly.
例句3 政策：A ban on open-weight models is difficult to enforce once the files are widely available.
可用场景：技术开放、知识共享、风险控制、教育公平。

cards.Back:
核心义：摆弄、修修补补、小幅改动。
语气：比 modify 口语、更随意，暗示非正式实验。
引申义：也可指对制度或政策做小修小补。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：anyone can run or tinker with open-weight models。开放权重让使用者不只是使用，还能改造。
例句1 科技：Students learn programming faster when they can tinker with real code.
例句2 政策：The government keeps tinkering with rules instead of redesigning the system.
例句3 学习：Instead of memorising blindly, learners should tinker with sentence patterns and use them in new contexts.
可用场景：技术学习、教育方法、制度改革、产品迭代。

cards.Back:
核心义：严厉打击，强力整治。
语气：政府/执法语境强，带控制、惩罚意味。
搭配：crack down on illegal trade / data abuse / exam cheating / pollution。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：American labs are cracking down on distillation. 美国实验室打击竞争者用强模型输出训练自己的模型。
政治意味：不仅是技术问题，也涉及技术垄断和竞争壁垒。
例句1 社会：Authorities should crack down on companies that misuse personal data.
例句2 教育：Schools may crack down on cheating, but they also need to teach academic integrity.
例句3 环境：Governments must crack down on factories that ignore pollution standards.
可用场景：法律、教育诚信、环境保护、平台治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：蒸馏。
AI 语境：用强模型的输出训练较小或竞争模型。
引申义：把复杂能力压缩、转移或提炼到另一个系统中。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：美国实验室打击 distillation，因为它可能帮助竞争者追赶。
暗示：知识一旦可通过输出转移，技术优势就更难长期封锁。
例句1 AI：Distillation can make powerful AI capabilities cheaper and easier to deploy.
例句2 学习：Good notes are a form of distillation: they turn complex arguments into usable ideas.
例句3 写作：Education should help students distil information into judgment, not merely collect facts.
可用场景：AI、学习方法、知识管理、教育写作。

cards.Back:
核心义：行不通的，不可操作的。
语气：政策评估词，强调方案在现实中无法执行。
近义：impractical, infeasible；但 unworkable 更像“机制上跑不通”。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：A permanent block is unworkable. 永久封锁 AI 模型不现实。
暗示：作者不是反对监管，而是反对无效监管。
例句1 科技：A total ban on smartphones in education may be unworkable.
例句2 环境：Environmental rules become unworkable if they ignore local economic realities.
例句3 作文：A policy that sounds strict may still be unworkable in practice.
可用场景：政策批判、教育改革、技术治理、经济管理。

cards.Back:
核心义：可塑的，易调整的。
本义：金属等可锤打成形。
引申义：想法、制度、模型、性格或学习方法容易被塑造。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Chinese models are cheap and malleable. 便宜且容易改造，所以很有吸引力。
暗示：malleable 不只是“灵活”，还暗示可被不同用户用于不同目的。
例句1 AI：Malleable models are attractive because firms can adapt them to specific tasks.
例句2 教育：Young minds are malleable, so good habits should be formed early.
例句3 写作：A malleable learning system can serve students with different needs.
可用场景：教育学习、AI 应用、个人品质、制度设计。

cards.Front: a gulf between A and B
cards.Back:
核心义：A 与 B 之间的巨大鸿沟。
语气：比 gap 更强，常表示难以跨越的差距。
搭配：a gulf between rich and poor / policy and reality / public and restricted models。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：a gulf between publicly available and restricted models。公开模型与受限模型之间能力差太大，会造成社会适应问题。
暗示：不平等访问会制造权力集中。
例句1 教育：There is a gulf between students who can use AI wisely and those who cannot.
例句2 社会：A gulf between urban and rural education can damage equal opportunity.
例句3 作文：Technology should narrow, not widen, the gulf between different social groups.
可用场景：教育公平、数字鸿沟、贫富差距、科技伦理。

cards.Back:
核心义：封存、压住、不让释放。
熟词辟义：bottle 是瓶子；bottle up 像把东西装进瓶里憋住。
语气：形象，有压抑后突然爆发的暗示。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：regulators bottled up several generations of AI advances。监管者如果把几代进步都封起来，最终释放会更混乱。
暗示/诙谐：技术进步像气体或压力，被封住越久越危险。
例句1 情绪：Students should not bottle up stress before exams.
例句2 科技：Bottling up innovation may create a sudden and disruptive release later.
例句3 社会：Public anger was bottled up for years before it finally erupted.
可用场景：科技治理、心理健康、社会矛盾、教育压力。

cards.Back:
核心义：分阶段发布、错峰发布。
引申义：把风险分散，让社会逐步适应。
语气：政策设计词，强调节奏控制。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：an evaluation period and a staggered release to trusted institutions。先评估，再分阶段给可信机构使用。
暗示：作者支持释放模型，但要控制节奏和对象。
例句1 科技：A staggered release can reduce the shock of powerful new technologies.
例句2 教育：Schools can introduce AI tools through a staggered release rather than a sudden rollout.
例句3 公共政策：Major reforms often work better with staggered implementation.
可用场景：AI 发布、教育改革、公共政策、产品上线。

cards.Back:
核心义：使正式化，使制度化。
引申义：把临时做法、默契或自愿规范变成明确规则。
语气：正式，常用于制度建设。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：分阶段发布是 good start, but it needs formalising。作者认为惯例还不够，要形成制度。
暗示：临时协商不可靠，制度化才可持续。
例句1 科技：AI safety practices should be formalised before models become widely available.
例句2 职场：Flexible work can succeed if expectations are formalised.
例句3 教育：Schools should formalise rules for the responsible use of AI tools.
可用场景：制度建设、职场管理、教育规范、科技治理。

cards.Back:
核心义：微观管理，过度干预细节。
语气：明显负面，表示领导者不懂放权。
政治意味：政治人物不应干预技术评估细节。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：politicians should not be micromanaging the process。作者区分政治目标与技术执行。
暗示：民主领导人定目标，专家做评估。
例句1 教育：Parents should guide children, but not micromanage every minute of their study.
例句2 职场：A good manager sets goals instead of micromanaging every task.
例句3 政策：Governments should regulate platforms, but they should not micromanage technical design.
可用场景：职场、教育、公共治理、科技监管。

cards.Back:
核心义：讨价还价，政治交易。
语气：贬义，暗示原则被交易替代。
诙谐/讽刺：原指买马卖马时讨价还价，转用于政治或商业交易，带粗俗现实感。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：politicians should not be horse-trading with AI companies。作者批评当前监管像政治交易。
政治意味：技术安全不应被公司利益和政治权力私下交换。
例句1 政治：Public health should not be reduced to horse-trading between politicians and companies.
例句2 教育：Education policy needs principles, not horse-trading among interest groups.
例句3 社会责任：When safety is at stake, horse-trading can undermine public trust.
可用场景：政治批评、商业伦理、社会责任、公共安全。

cards.Back:
核心义：退后一步，不插手细节。
引申义：在设定目标后给专家、市场或执行者空间。
语气：理性克制，常用于治理分工。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Once those goals are set, politicians should stand back. 政治人物设定风险目标后应让技术评估者工作。
暗示：好治理不是缺席，而是边界清晰。
例句1 教育：Once learning goals are clear, teachers should stand back and let students explore.
例句2 职场：Leaders should stand back after giving teams a clear direction.
例句3 政策：Politicians should stand back when scientific expertise is required.
可用场景：教育、职场领导、科技治理、专家决策。

cards.Back:
核心义：整合、合并。
语气：正式，常用于把不同来源的信息、机构、资源合并。
区别：比 combine 更书面，强调融合成一个整体。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：amalgamate knowledge from AI labs, research groups and foreign bodies。AI 监管需要整合多方专业知识。
例句1 学习：Good writing amalgamates evidence, logic and personal judgment.
例句2 科技：AI governance should amalgamate expertise from engineers, lawyers and ethicists.
例句3 职场：A strong team can amalgamate different skills into one practical solution.
可用场景：知识整合、团队合作、科技治理、作文表达升级。

cards.Back:
核心义：建立筹码，增强议价能力。
熟词辟义：leverage 本义为杠杆，引申为影响力、筹码、可支配优势。
语气：战略性强，常用于国家、企业、个人竞争。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Other countries must build leverage with their own AI sectors and regulations. 其他国家不能完全被美国出口管制牵着走。
政治意味：技术自主就是谈判筹码。
例句1 个人发展：Young people can build leverage by mastering skills that are hard to replace.
例句2 国家竞争：Countries build leverage when they develop independent technologies.
例句3 职场：A worker with rare expertise has more leverage in the job market.
可用场景：职场发展、科技自主、国家战略、个人品质。

cards.Back:
核心义：失效保护，备用安全机制。
引申义：当主系统失灵时仍能防止严重损失的备份方案。
语气：工程、风险管理和公共治理常用。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：find fail-safes for American export controls。其他国家要准备不被美国管制卡死的备用机制。
暗示：依赖美国比依赖中国好，但单一依赖仍有风险。
例句1 个人：Students need fail-safes, such as backup plans, when preparing for important exams.
例句2 经济：Supply chains need fail-safes against political shocks.
例句3 科技：Critical systems should include fail-safes before they are widely deployed.
可用场景：风险管理、考研规划、供应链、科技安全。

cards.Back:
结构：The intelligence + that 定语从句 + also + 谓语。
功能：表达“双刃剑”：同一个特征既制造风险，也创造价值。
适合背诵：科技、教育、社交媒体、基因技术都能套。
cards.Extra:
原文逻辑：The intelligence that makes new models dangerous also makes them tremendously useful. 作者承认风险，同时反对简单封锁。
例句1 社交媒体：The connectivity that makes social media distracting also makes it valuable for public communication.
例句2 教育：The pressure that makes exams stressful also makes them a test of discipline.
例句3 科技：The power that makes new technology disruptive also makes it socially valuable.
可用场景：考研作文“科技双刃剑”核心句式。

cards.Back: 中心论点：前沿 AI 需要监管，但监管应当正式化、专业化、分阶段，并具备国际韧性；不能靠临时拼凑规则、政治交易或狭隘民族主义。
cards.Extra:
可背作文论点：Powerful technology should be governed by clear rules, expert evaluation and social responsibility.
例句1：Innovation should not be strangled, but it must be guided by rules that protect the public.
例句2：A mature society regulates technology before harm becomes irreversible.
例句3：International cooperation is necessary because digital risks rarely stop at national borders.
适用话题：科技生活、道德文明、社会责任、国际合作、经济安全。

cards.Back:
核心义：揭黑记者，揭露社会丑闻的人。
语气：新闻/历史词，带改革时代色彩。
引申义：揭露制度问题、推动公共改革的人。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：muckrakers such as Upton Sinclair 促成 FDA。
暗示：公众监督和媒体揭露能倒逼制度改进。
例句1：Muckrakers can force society to confront hidden abuses.
例句2：Good journalism should expose problems rather than entertain the public only.
可用场景：媒体责任、社会监督、公共伦理。

cards.Back:
核心义：导致，引起，促成。
语气：中性，考研高频因果动词短语。
区别：比 cause 更偏“促成某种变化/结果”。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Pressure from muckrakers brought about the FDA。
例句1：Education can bring about long-term social change.
例句2：Technological progress may bring about new ethical problems.
例句3：Public pressure can bring about better environmental rules.
可用场景：因果论证、教育、环境、科技。

cards.Back:
核心义：有能力的顾问。
引申义：不只是能回答问题，而是能提供可操作建议。
语气：在危险语境中带警惕意味。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：AI could become capable advisers to bioterrorists。
暗示：AI 的危险在于能指导行动，而非只提供信息。
例句1：AI can be a capable adviser for students, but it should not replace independent thinking.
例句2：A capable adviser helps people make decisions, not merely collect facts.
可用场景：AI、教育学习、道德责任。

cards.Back:
核心义：灾难降临。
搭配：before catastrophe strikes = 在灾难发生之前。
语气：强烈、警示，适合风险预防话题。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：regulate the technology before catastrophe strikes。
例句1：Governments should act before catastrophe strikes, not after harm is irreversible.
例句2：Students should correct bad habits before failure strikes.
可用场景：科技风险、环境保护、健康管理、备考规划。

cards.Front: a row between A and B
cards.Back:
核心义：A 与 B 之间的争吵/争端。
熟词辟义：row 作名词时可表示争吵，读音不同于 row a boat。
语气：英式新闻常用。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：a row between the company and the Pentagon。
例句1：A row between parents and schools can harm students' interests.
例句2：The policy triggered a row between regulators and technology firms.
可用场景：新闻阅读、政策争议、教育冲突。

cards.Back:
核心义：缓解担忧，减轻恐惧。
语气：正式，新闻和政策报道常用。
搭配：allay concerns / fears / doubts。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Fears of a grudge were allayed。
例句1：Clear rules can allay public fears about AI.
例句2：Transparent communication helps allay parents' concerns.
例句3：Scientific evidence can allay unnecessary panic.
可用场景：科技治理、教育沟通、公共健康。

cards.Back:
核心义：迫使某人做某事。
语气：正式、强制性强，比 make sb do 更书面。
政治/法律意味：常用于政府、法律、制度压力。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：administration appeared to compel OpenAI to limit access。
例句1：Law can compel companies to protect user data.
例句2：Exams may compel students to study, but interest keeps them learning.
可用场景：法律监管、教育、社会责任。

cards.Back:
核心义：突然解除禁令。
语气：abruptly 暗示决定突兀、缺乏连续性。
搭配：lift a ban / restriction / lockdown。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Commerce Department abruptly lifted the ban on Fable。
暗示：政策摇摆，缺乏稳定规则。
例句1：A government should not abruptly lift restrictions without explaining its reasons.
例句2：Schools should avoid abrupt changes in exam policy.
可用场景：政策稳定、公共治理、学校管理。

cards.Back:
核心义：摆弄，随手调整。
语气：略随意，可能暗示小修小改、不够根本。
熟词：fiddle 还可指小提琴，但这里不是。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：Anthropic fiddled with its safety protections。
暗示：只是调整保护措施就解除禁令，显得监管不严肃。
例句1：Do not fiddle with learning methods every day; give one system enough time.
例句2：Companies often fiddle with settings instead of solving deeper safety problems.
可用场景：学习方法、产品安全、政策批评。

cards.Back:
核心义：事实上的禁令。
拉丁词：de facto = 实际上存在的，不一定写在法律上。
政治意味：表面不是禁止，实际效果等于禁止。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：a wholesale block was a de facto ban。
例句1：High fees can become a de facto ban on poor students entering good schools.
例句2：Complex rules may create a de facto barrier to innovation.
可用场景：教育公平、社会政策、科技监管、经济门槛。

cards.Back:
核心义：国内市场，本土市场。
语气：经济报道常用。
引申义：一个国家内部需求可支撑企业生存和发展。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：a vast home market would keep China's model-makers going。
暗示：外部封锁不一定有效，因为国内市场足够大。
例句1：A large home market can support local innovation.
例句2：Companies with a strong home market are less vulnerable to foreign pressure.
可用场景：经济发展、科技竞争、国际贸易。

cards.Back:
核心义：公开可获得的。
语气：正式，常用于数据、资源、模型、信息。
反义：restricted / private / confidential。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：a gulf between publicly available and restricted models。
例句1：Publicly available educational resources can reduce inequality.
例句2：Not all publicly available information is reliable.
可用场景：教育资源、信息素养、AI 模型、公共服务。

cards.Back:
核心义：释放混乱，引发大乱。
语气：强烈，unleash 暗示把原本被压住的力量放出来。
搭配：unleash creativity / violence / chaos / potential。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：能力突然跃升 would unleash chaos。
例句1：A sudden release of powerful technology may unleash chaos.
例句2：Poorly planned reforms can unleash confusion in schools.
例句3：Education should unleash potential, not anxiety.
可用场景：科技风险、教育改革、社会治理、个人潜能。

cards.Back:
核心义：可信机构。
引申义：被认为有能力、有责任、有规则约束的组织。
语气：政策/治理语境常用。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：staggered release to trusted institutions。
暗示：不是所有人立刻使用，而是先给有责任能力的机构。
例句1：Sensitive data should be shared only with trusted institutions.
例句2：Universities can serve as trusted institutions in public debates.
可用场景：AI 安全、公共卫生、教育机构、社会信任。

cards.Back:
核心义：可容忍的风险。
搭配：how much risk to tolerate。
语气：政策决策词，强调价值判断。
cards.Extra:
文章语境：how much risk to tolerate belongs to elected leaders。
暗示：技术专家能评估风险，但社会能接受多少风险是政治问题。
例句1：A society must decide how much risk to tolerate in exchange for innovation.
例句2：Students should know how much risk to tolerate when choosing a career path.
可用场景：科技伦理、职业选择、公共政策。
